description: (Li)₂NaMoF₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Li clusters inside a NaMoF₆ framework. In each Li cluster, Li is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaMoF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.17 Å. Mo is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form MoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mo-F bond lengths are 2.05 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mo atom.
